name: Start
title: Start by *creating a project*
lede: For this tutorial, start from an empty project: --bare writes the config and an empty fronds/, and nothing else. A real project usually starts with a frond and an app — npm create fougere asks.
fig: A config, a package.json, an empty fronds/. Step 1 writes the first domain in it.
whatIf: you want pages from the start? Add --app nuxt to the command: the same project comes with a Nuxt app. Every step below is the same, and step 7 shows how a page calls what you write.
install: npm create fougere my-blog --bare && cd my-blog && npm install
